items.title: 实义动词与助动词的界限
items.brief: 能否独立作谓语，决定它是实义还是助动

concept.summary: 判定只看一条：这个词能否单独承担谓语。能单独作谓语、带完整词汇意义的是实义动词；不能单独作谓语、必须与另一个动词或分词共同构成谓语的是助动词。第二个判据是否定与疑问：需要另加 do 的是实义动词，自己就能加 not 或直接倒装的是助动词。

sections.p: 先做孤立测试：把这个词单独放进 He ___ 的位置，句子成立且意义完整，它是实义动词。再做否定测试：否定时是直接加 not，还是必须另请 do，直接加 not 的本身就是助动词。
bullets: 实义：He works. / He has a car. / She does her homework.
助动：He has left. / She is working. / He does not work.
同一形式两种身份：He has a car.（实义）→ He has bought a car.（助动）

sections.p: 基本助动词 be/do/have 承担时态、语态、疑问与否定；情态助动词 can/may/must 等表语气；半助动词 be going to、have to、used to、ought to 形式上是实义动词，功能接近情态动词。
bullets: 基本助动词后接分词或原形：is doing / has done / does not do
情态助动词后接原形，没有人称与数的变化：He can swim.
半助动词保留实义动词的屈折：He has to go. / He used to smoke.

sections.h: 实义动词的否定必须借 do
sections.p: 现代英语中实义动词不能直接加 not，也不能直接提前构成疑问，必须由 do/does/did 承担人称与时态，实义动词退回原形。这一条同时解释了第三人称单数为什么落在 do 上。
bullets: × He not likes tea. → √ He does not like tea.
× Does he likes tea? → √ Does he like tea?
have 作“拥有”讲时同样借 do：√ Does he have any money?

examples.en: She does her homework in the library every afternoon.
examples.zh: 她每天下午在图书馆做作业。
examples.note: does 在此为实义动词，带宾语 her homework，义为“做”。

examples.en: She does not do her homework in the evening.
examples.zh: 她晚上不做作业。
examples.note: 第一个 does 是助动词承担否定，第二个 do 是实义动词。

examples.en: He has two brothers and a sister.
examples.zh: 他有两个兄弟和一个妹妹。
examples.note: has 表示“拥有”，是实义动词，疑问句需借 do：Does he have...?

examples.en: He not goes to school by bus.
examples.zh: 他不坐公交车上学。
examples.note: 实义动词不能直接加 not，须由助动词承担否定：He does not go to school by bus.

examples.en: He cans swim across the river.
examples.zh: 他能游过这条河。
examples.note: can 是情态助动词，没有第三人称单数形式，应改为 He can swim。

examples.en: The room is cleaned every morning.
examples.zh: 这个房间每天早上打扫。
examples.note: is 为助动词，与过去分词构成被动语态，本身不表示“是”。

examples.en: He doesn't has enough time for the rehearsal.
examples.zh: 他没有足够时间参加排练。
examples.note: 否定已由 doesn't 承担，实义动词须用原形 have。

pitfalls.wrong: He not finished the report.
pitfalls.right: He did not finish the report.
pitfalls.why: 实义动词的否定必须由 do 的相应形式承担时态与人称，实义动词退回原形，not 不能直接跟在实义动词前。

pitfalls.wrong: Does she likes classical music?
pitfalls.right: Does she like classical music?
pitfalls.why: 助动词 does 已承担第三人称单数信息，实义动词不再加 s。

pitfalls.wrong: He is work in a bank.
pitfalls.right: He works in a bank.
pitfalls.why: be 只有在进行时或被动语态中才是助动词，不能与动词原形直接连用；一般现在时直接用实义动词 works。

contrast.withTitle: 助动词 do 的强调与替代
contrast.diff: 本知识点分辨一个形式是实义还是助动；do 的强调与替代讲的是助动词 do 在肯定句与替代结构中的额外功能。

concept.mnemonic: 能单独作谓语是实义，必须拉着别人才能作谓语是助动。

core: 判定一：能否单独作谓语——能则实义，不能则助动
判定二：否定是加 not 还是借 do——借 do 的是实义动词
基本助动词 be/do/have 管时态、语态、疑问、否定
情态助动词后接原形，没有第三人称单数
半助动词 have to / be going to / used to 保留实义动词的屈折
review.trigger: 看到句中出现两个动词形式 → 先问谁承担时态和人称 → 前一个是助动词，后一个按助动词的要求变形

quickCheck.q: He has a car. 与 He has bought a car. 中的 has 有何不同？
quickCheck.a: 前者是实义动词“拥有”，后者是构成现在完成时的助动词。

quickCheck.q: 实义动词的否定句为什么不能说 doesn't likes？
quickCheck.a: does 已承担第三人称单数，实义动词必须用原形 like。

quickCheck.q: can 有第三人称单数形式吗？
quickCheck.a: 没有，情态助动词一律用原形。

drills.stem: She ___ her homework in the school library every afternoon.
drills.explain: 此处需要实义动词“做”，主语 She 为第三人称单数，用 does；is 与 has 都不能与后面的名词宾语构成“做作业”这一意义。
drills.trap: do 忽略了第三人称单数；is 则误把 be 当作可与实义动词连用的助动词。

drills.stem: He ___ (not have) any brothers or sisters, so he often spends holidays alone.
drills.hint: have 作“拥有”讲是实义动词，否定要借 do。
drills.explain: have 表示“拥有”时为实义动词，否定由 doesn't 承担，have 用原形。

drills.stem: He doesn't has enough time to prepare for the interview.
drills.answer: He doesn't have enough time to prepare for the interview.
accept: He doesn't have enough time to prepare for the interview.
drills.explain: 助动词 doesn't 已承担否定与第三人称单数，实义动词 have 必须用原形。

drills.stem: 在句子“He has finished the report”中，has 的语法功能是 ___。
drills.explain: has 后接过去分词 finished，共同构成现在完成时，本身不表示“拥有”，因此是助动词。
drills.trap: 受 has 常见义“拥有”的影响而误判为实义动词，但此处它没有独立的词汇意义。

drills.stem: 他没有完成报告，因为他那天病了。
drills.answer: He didn't finish the report because he was ill that day.
drills.explain: 实义动词 finish 的否定由 did 承担，finish 用原形；because 引导原因状语从句。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She does not have any classes on Friday.
drills.explain: have 作“有”讲是实义动词，否定由 does not 承担，have 保持原形。

items.title: 及物与不及物动词的判定
items.brief: 删宾测试与被动测试，两条都指向及物性

concept.summary: 判定及物性用两步测试：删去动词后的名词，看句子是否还站得住；再把句子改成被动，看能否成立。删掉后意义残缺、且能变被动的是及物动词；意义完整、不能变被动的是不及物动词。汉语及物而英语不及物的动词必须带介词，这是最高频的失分点。

sections.p: 先做删宾测试，再做被动测试，两个测试指向同一结论时才可靠。有些动词两栖，必须按具体义项判断，不能凭词形下结论。
bullets: 及物：She wrote a letter. → 删去 a letter 句子残缺；→ A letter was written by her.
不及物：The baby slept. → 删去后仍完整；× The baby was slept.
两栖：He runs a bookshop.（及物）/ He runs every morning.（不及物）

sections.h: 汉语及物、英语不及物的高频词
sections.p: 这类动词在汉语里可以直接带宾语，在英语里必须借助固定介词。介词是动词短语的一部分，不能省略，也不能换成别的介词。
bullets: listen to music / wait for the bus / arrive at the station
agree with sb / depend on sth / laugh at sb
reply to the letter / apologize to sb for sth / respond to the question
discuss sth（不加 about）/ enter the room（不加 into）/ marry sb（不加 with）

sections.p: 同一动词常有一个及物义项和一个不及物义项，宾语出现与否会改变词义，判断依据是句中有没有宾语以及该义项是否成立。
bullets: sell：The shop sells books.（及物）/ The book sells well.（不及物，主动表被动）
grow：He grows roses.（及物）/ The roses grow fast.（不及物）
change：She changed her dress.（及物）/ The weather has changed.（不及物）

examples.en: She listened to the lecture with great attention.
examples.zh: 她非常专注地听了那场讲座。
examples.note: listen 是不及物动词，必须借助介词 to 才能带宾语。

examples.en: She listened the lecture with great attention.
examples.zh: 她非常专注地听了那场讲座。
examples.note: listen 不能直接带宾语，须补介词 to。

examples.en: The accident happened at about nine last night.
examples.zh: 事故发生在昨晚九点左右。
examples.note: happen 是不及物动词，没有宾语，也没有被动形式。

examples.en: The accident was happened at about nine last night.
examples.zh: 事故发生在昨晚九点左右。
examples.note: happen 不及物，不能构成被动语态。

examples.en: He runs a small bookshop near the station.
examples.zh: 他在车站附近经营一家小书店。
examples.note: run 在此为及物动词，义为“经营”，后接宾语 a small bookshop。

examples.en: He runs in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上在公园跑步。
examples.note: 同一动词的不及物用法，表示“跑步”，不带宾语。

examples.en: The manager discussed about the new schedule with us.
examples.zh: 经理和我们讨论了新的日程安排。
examples.note: discuss 是及物动词，直接带宾语，不加 about。

pitfalls.wrong: We waited the bus for twenty minutes.
pitfalls.right: We waited for the bus for twenty minutes.
pitfalls.why: wait 是不及物动词，宾语必须由介词 for 引出。

pitfalls.wrong: The war was broken out in 1937.
pitfalls.right: The war broke out in 1937.
pitfalls.why: break out 是不及物的短语动词，没有被动形式。

pitfalls.wrong: He arrived the airport at six.
pitfalls.right: He arrived at the airport at six.
pitfalls.why: arrive 不及物，大地点用 in、小地点用 at，介词不可省。

contrast.diff: 本知识点判断动词能否直接带宾语；短语动词部分讲的是已经带了介词的动词如何安排宾语的位置。

concept.mnemonic: 先删宾语看句子，再变被动看能否；汉语及物英语不及，补个介词才成型。

core: 删宾测试：去掉后面的名词，句子残缺 → 及物
被动测试：能变被动 → 及物；不能 → 不及物
listen to / wait for / arrive at / agree with / depend on 必须带介词
discuss / enter / marry / reach 是及物动词，不加 about/into/with/at
两栖动词按义项判断：run a shop 及物，run fast 不及物
review.trigger: 看到动词后面直接跟名词 → 先查这个词是否必须带介词 → 再决定能否直接变被动

quickCheck.q: happen 能用于被动语态吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，happen 是不及物动词，没有被动形式。

quickCheck.q: “讨论这个问题”英语怎么说？
quickCheck.a: discuss the problem，不加 about。

quickCheck.q: The book sells well. 中 sell 为什么用主动形式？
quickCheck.a: sell 在此为不及物用法，主语是物，主动形式表被动意义。

drills.stem: The students ___ the lecture carefully and took notes in the margin.
drills.explain: listen 是不及物动词，带宾语须用介词 to；listened for 意为“等着听到”，与“认真听讲座”不符。
drills.trap: listened 直接带宾语，是汉语“听讲座”的逐字直译。

drills.stem: We waited ___ the bus for nearly half an hour before it finally came.
drills.hint: wait 是不及物动词，宾语要由介词引出。
drills.explain: wait 不及物，宾语由介词 for 引出，wait for sth 是固定搭配。

drills.stem: The manager discussed about the new schedule with his team.
drills.answer: The manager discussed the new schedule with his team.
accept: The manager discussed the new schedule with his team.
drills.explain: discuss 是及物动词，直接带宾语，about 是多余的介词。

drills.stem: The little bookshop ___ well because its prices are reasonable and the staff are friendly.
drills.explain: sell 在此为不及物用法，主语是物，主动形式表被动意义，与 well 搭配表示“销路好”。
drills.trap: is sold 套用了被动语态，但 sell well 是固定的主动表被动结构。

drills.stem: 这起事故发生在昨天下午。
drills.explain: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动形式，直接用主动语态加时间状语。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She listened to the music in complete silence.
drills.explain: listen 后必须带介词 to 才能接宾语 the music。

items.title: 系动词的分类与用法
items.brief: 系动词接表语用形容词，换成 be 仍成立

concept.summary: 系动词后面接的是表语而不是宾语，因此后面出现形容词而不是副词，是识别系动词最直接的信号。判定方法是替换：把该动词换成 be，句子结构与意义基本不变，即可确认它是系动词。同一个动词既可作系动词也可作实义动词，区别在于后面接形容词还是副词、是否带宾语。

sections.h: 判定：换成 be 测试
sections.p: 把动词换成 be，若句子仍然成立且意思接近，该动词在此是系动词。系动词后的成分说明主语的性质或状态，不能用副词。
bullets: The soup tastes good. → The soup is good.（成立，tastes 为系动词）
He tasted the soup carefully. → × He is the soup.（不成立，tasted 为实义动词）
系动词后接形容词、名词或介词短语：feel cold / become a doctor / remain in bed

sections.p: 按语义分组记忆，考场上按“状态—感官—变化—持续—表象结果”五条线检索。
bullets: 状态：be
感官：look, sound, smell, taste, feel
变化：become, get, grow, turn, go, come, fall
持续：remain, stay, keep, continue, hold
表象与结果：seem, appear, prove, turn out

sections.h: 感官动词与变化动词的两个限制
sections.p: 感官动词后接形容词表主语特征，接副词则说明动作方式；变化类系动词中 turn 后接名词时不加冠词，go 多接表示恶化或异常的形容词。
bullets: The music sounds beautiful.（系动词 + 形容词）/ He looked at me angrily.（实义 + 副词）
He turned writer after graduation.（turn + 名词，不用冠词）
The milk went bad. / He went pale at the news.

examples.en: The soup tastes a little salty.
examples.zh: 这汤尝起来有点咸。
examples.note: taste 为感官系动词，后接形容词 salty 说明主语特征。

examples.en: The soup tastes a little saltily.
examples.zh: 这汤尝起来有点咸。
examples.note: 系动词后接形容词作表语，不能改用副词 saltily。

examples.en: She looked at the broken vase angrily.
examples.zh: 她生气地看着那个碎掉的花瓶。
examples.note: look at 是实义动词短语，修饰动作方式用副词 angrily。

examples.en: He remained silent throughout the meeting.
examples.zh: 整个会议期间他一直沉默。
examples.note: remain 是持续类系动词，后接形容词 silent 作表语。

examples.en: The music sounds beautifully through these headphones.
examples.zh: 用这副耳机听，音乐听起来很美。
examples.note: sound 是感官系动词，表语用形容词 beautiful。

examples.en: The leaves turn yellow in late autumn.
examples.zh: 叶子在深秋变黄。
examples.note: turn 是变化类系动词，后接形容词表示状态变化。

examples.en: His explanation proved correct after the test.
examples.zh: 测试之后证明他的解释是正确的。
examples.note: prove 是结果类系动词，后接形容词表示“被证明是”。

pitfalls.wrong: The cake smells sweetly.
pitfalls.right: The cake smells sweet.
pitfalls.why: smell 在此是感官系动词，表语说明主语的性质，用形容词而非副词。

pitfalls.wrong: She felt badly about the mistake.
pitfalls.right: She felt bad about the mistake.
pitfalls.why: feel 作系动词表“感到”，后接形容词；badly 是副词，只修饰动作方式。

pitfalls.wrong: The weather is getting more and more coldly.
pitfalls.right: The weather is getting colder and colder.
pitfalls.why: get 是变化类系动词，表语用比较级形容词，不能用副词。

contrast.withTitle: 形容词作定语与表语的位置限制
contrast.diff: 本知识点辨认“动词后为什么用形容词”；形容词部分处理形容词本身在句中的位置与后置条件。

concept.mnemonic: 系动词后接表语，表语用形容词；换成 be 还成立，就是系动词。

core: 系动词 + 表语，表语用形容词而非副词
换 be 测试：替换后句子成立 → 系动词
五类：be / 感官 / 变化 / 持续 / 表象结果
look at、taste sth 带宾语时是实义动词，用副词修饰
turn 后接名词不加冠词：He turned writer.
review.trigger: 看到动词后面直接跟形容词 → 先换成 be 试一次 → 成立就按系动词处理，不要再改成副词

quickCheck.q: The music sounds ___ (beautiful). 填什么？
quickCheck.a: beautiful，sound 是感官系动词。

quickCheck.q: look at 后面修饰动作方式用什么词性？
quickCheck.a: 副词，如 He looked at me angrily.

quickCheck.q: turn 后接名词时要不要冠词？
quickCheck.a: 不要，如 He turned writer.

drills.stem: The soup ___ a little salty, so I added some water to it.
drills.explain: taste 在此为感官系动词，后接形容词 salty 作表语；主语 The soup 为单数，谓语用 tastes。
drills.trap: tastes like 后必须接名词，salty 是形容词，不能作 like 的宾语。

drills.stem: The news sounds ___ (encourage) to everyone in the room.
drills.hint: sound 是感官系动词，表语说明主语给人的感受。
drills.explain: sound 后接形容词作表语；说明事物给人的感受用 -ing 形式的 encouraging。

drills.stem: The music sounds beautifully through these new headphones.
drills.answer: The music sounds beautiful through these new headphones.
accept: The music sounds beautiful through these new headphones.
drills.explain: sound 是感官系动词，表语用形容词 beautiful；beautifully 是副词，不能作表语。

drills.stem: The leaves ___ yellow as soon as the cold weather arrives.
drills.explain: turn 是变化类系动词，直接接形容词表示状态变化，主语复数用原形 turn。
drills.trap: turn to 意为“转向、求助于”，后面接名词，不能接形容词 yellow。

drills.stem: 这汤闻起来很香，但尝起来有点咸。
drills.answer: The soup smells delicious, but it tastes a little salty.
drills.explain: smell 与 taste 都是感官系动词，表语用形容词；well 与 saltily 是副词，不能作表语。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The weather is getting warmer day by day.
drills.explain: get 是变化类系动词，后接比较级形容词 warmer 作表语。

items.title: 瞬间动词与延续动词
items.brief: 瞬间动词不能接时间段，需换状态表达

concept.summary: 瞬间动词表示动作在一瞬间完成，不能与 for/since/how long 等表示一段时间的状语连用；延续动词表示可以持续的状态或动作，可以与时间段连用。判断方法是把动词放进“for + 一段时间”的框架：句子成立则是延续动词，不成立就必须改用状态表达。改写有三条路径：换状态词、用 It is ... since 句型、以及把句子改成否定。

sections.p: 瞬间动词的完成时只表示动作已完成，不表示状态持续；一旦加上时间段，语法上就要求动词本身能延续，因此必须换词。
bullets: 瞬间：arrive, leave, begin, start, stop, finish, buy, borrow, lend, die, join, marry, open, close, fall asleep, catch a cold
延续：live, study, work, keep, have, know, be, stay, wait, sleep
× He has died for three years. → √ He has been dead for three years.

sections.p: 改写时保留原句的时间信息，只替换谓语部分，不要改动主语与时间状语。
bullets: 换状态词：die → be dead；leave → be away；buy → have；borrow → keep；join → be in；begin → be on
It is / has been + 时间段 + since + 一般过去时：It is three years since he joined the army.
否定式可接时间段：I haven't seen him for two years.（see 是瞬间动词，但否定形式表示状态）

sections.p: 考试中反复出现的六组替换要形成条件反射，看到瞬间动词加时间段就先换状态词。
bullets: die → be dead；marry → be married to
leave → be away from；come/go → be here / be there
buy → have；borrow → keep；open → be open；close → be closed
join → be in；begin/start → be on；end/finish → be over

examples.en: His grandfather has been dead for nearly ten years.
examples.zh: 他祖父去世将近十年了。
examples.note: die 是瞬间动词，与时间段连用须换成状态 be dead。

examples.en: His grandfather has died for nearly ten years.
examples.zh: 他祖父去世将近十年了。
examples.note: die 不能与 for 引导的时间段连用，应改为 has been dead。

examples.en: She has kept my dictionary for over a month.
examples.zh: 她借我的词典已经一个多月了。
examples.note: borrow 是瞬间动词，与时间段连用换成延续动词 keep。

examples.en: She has borrowed my dictionary for over a month.
examples.zh: 她借我的词典已经一个多月了。
examples.note: borrow 表示一次性借入，不能延续，应改为 has kept。

examples.en: It is three years since he joined the army.
examples.zh: 他参军已经三年了。
examples.note: 瞬间动词 join 放在 since 从句中用一般过去时，主句用 It is + 时间段。

examples.en: The film has been on for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 电影已经开演十分钟了。
examples.note: begin 是瞬间动词，与时间段连用换成 be on。

examples.en: He has left home for two hours.
examples.zh: 他离家已经两个小时了。
examples.note: leave 是瞬间动词，应改为 has been away from home for two hours。

pitfalls.wrong: I have bought this bicycle for three years.
pitfalls.right: I have had this bicycle for three years.
pitfalls.why: buy 表示一次性购买动作，不能延续三年，与时间段连用须换成状态动词 have。

pitfalls.wrong: The meeting has begun for twenty minutes.
pitfalls.right: The meeting has been on for twenty minutes.
pitfalls.why: begin 是瞬间动词，其完成时不表示持续，需换成 be on。

pitfalls.wrong: She has married him for ten years.
pitfalls.right: She has been married to him for ten years.
pitfalls.why: marry 是瞬间动词，表示持续的婚姻状态要用 be married to。

contrast.withTitle: 现在完成时的延续用法与时间标志
contrast.diff: 本知识点解决“哪些动词根本不能接时间段”；现在完成时的延续用法讲的是 for 与 since 的选择以及时间标志的识别。

concept.mnemonic: 一秒完成的动作，不接 for 和 since；要接就换状态词，be dead、be away、have、keep。

core: 瞬间动词一秒完成：arrive/leave/begin/buy/borrow/die/join/marry
瞬间动词不能与 for/since/how long 连用
改写路径一：换状态词 be dead / be away / have / keep / be on
改写路径二：It is + 时间段 + since + 一般过去时
否定式可接时间段：I haven't seen him for years.
review.trigger: 看到瞬间动词 + for/since/时间段 → 立刻换状态词，或改成 It is ... since 句型

quickCheck.q: “他去世三年了”怎么说？
quickCheck.a: He has been dead for three years.

quickCheck.q: borrow 与时间段连用要换成什么？
quickCheck.a: keep，如 I have kept the book for a week.

quickCheck.q: begin 的延续表达是什么？
quickCheck.a: be on，如 The film has been on for ten minutes.

drills.stem: His grandfather ___ for nearly ten years, but the family still talks about him.
drills.explain: die 是瞬间动词，与 for nearly ten years 连用须换成状态 be dead，并用现在完成时。
drills.trap: has died 形式正确但语义上不能延续十年，是最强干扰项。

drills.stem: She ___ (keep) my dictionary for over a month and still hasn't returned it.
drills.hint: borrow 是瞬间动词，与时间段连用要换延续动词。
drills.explain: 与 for over a month 连用须用延续动词 keep，句子为现在完成时，故填 has kept。

drills.stem: I have bought this bicycle for three years.
drills.answer: I have had this bicycle for three years.
accept: I have had this bicycle for three years.
drills.explain: buy 是瞬间动词，动作不能延续三年，与时间段连用须换成状态动词 have。

drills.stem: The meeting has ___ for twenty minutes, but no decision has been made.
drills.explain: begin 是瞬间动词，与时间段连用须换成 be on，构成 has been on。
drills.trap: begun 是 begin 的过去分词，形式正确但同样不能接时间段。

drills.stem: 他离开家乡已经三年了。
drills.answer: He has been away from his hometown for three years.
forbid: has left his hometown for three years
left his hometown for three years
drills.explain: leave 是瞬间动词，与时间段连用须换成状态 be away from。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He has been in the army for three years.
drills.explain: join 是瞬间动词，与时间段连用换成状态 be in the army。

items.title: 动词的四种基本形式
items.brief: 四形式各有岗位，过去式只作谓语

concept.summary: 动词有原形、过去式、过去分词、现在分词四种形式，各有固定的句法岗位：过去式只能作谓语；过去分词用于完成时、被动语态和分词短语；现在分词用于进行时与主动意义的非谓语。规则变化取决于词尾 -ed/-ing 的拼写规则，不规则变化按 AAA/ABB/ABC/ABA 四类整记。判断用哪一种，先看它前面有没有助动词，再看是主动还是被动。

sections.p: 同一个动词用哪一种形式，由它在谓语中的角色决定，不由时间单独决定。
bullets: 原形：情态动词后、do 之后、祈使句：He can swim. / Does he swim?
过去式：只作谓语，表示过去：He swam across the river.
过去分词：have/has/had 后、be 后、作定语或状语：He has swum. / a broken window
现在分词：be 后、作定语或状语：He is swimming. / the swimming boy

sections.p: 两条规则都取决于词尾的发音与重音位置，拼写错误在语法填空中同样算错。
bullets: 去 e：make → making, write → writing；但 see → seeing, be → being 保留 e
双写末尾辅音：run → running, begin → beginning, prefer → preferred
ie → y：lie → lying, die → dying, tie → tying
-ed：stop → stopped, plan → planned；carry → carried；play → played

sections.p: 按三态是否相同分组记忆，比按字母顺序背更有效，也更容易在写作时回忆。
bullets: AAA：cut-cut-cut, put-put-put, cost-cost-cost
ABB：buy-bought-bought, teach-taught-taught, keep-kept-kept
ABC：go-went-gone, write-wrote-written, begin-began-begun
ABA：come-came-come, become-became-become, run-ran-run

examples.en: The letter was written by the manager yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 这封信是经理昨天上午写的。
examples.note: write 的过去分词 written 与 be 构成被动语态。

examples.en: The letter was wrote by the manager yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 这封信是经理昨天上午写的。
examples.note: 被动语态用过去分词，write 的过去分词是 written，不是过去式 wrote。

examples.en: She has begun to learn French this term.
examples.zh: 她这学期开始学法语。
examples.note: 现在完成时用 has + 过去分词 begun。

examples.en: She has began to learn French this term.
examples.zh: 她这学期开始学法语。
examples.note: has 后必须用过去分词 begun，began 是过去式。

examples.en: The children were bored by the long lecture.
examples.zh: 孩子们被那场冗长的讲座弄得厌烦。
examples.note: bored 是过去分词转化的形容词，说明人的感受。

examples.en: The long lecture was boring, so several students fell asleep.
examples.zh: 那场讲座很乏味，几个学生睡着了。
examples.note: boring 是现在分词转化的形容词，说明事物令人乏味。

examples.en: The boy was very exciting about the school trip.
examples.zh: 这个男孩对学校组织的旅行很兴奋。
examples.note: 说明人的感受用过去分词 excited，exciting 用于说明事物。

pitfalls.wrong: He has drank three cups of coffee this morning.
pitfalls.right: He has drunk three cups of coffee this morning.
pitfalls.why: have 后接过去分词，drink 的三态是 drink-drank-drunk。

pitfalls.wrong: The window was broke by a stone.
pitfalls.right: The window was broken by a stone.
pitfalls.why: 被动语态用过去分词 broken，broke 是过去式，不能跟在 be 后。

pitfalls.wrong: The film was really bored, so we left early.
pitfalls.right: The film was really boring, so we left early.
pitfalls.why: -ing 形容词说明事物引起的感受，-ed 形容词说明人的感受，主语是 film 故用 boring。

contrast.withTitle: 过去式与过去分词形式的易混
contrast.diff: 本知识点建立四种形式的完整岗位表；时态部分只针对过去式与过去分词这一对做专项辨析。

concept.mnemonic: 过去式只作谓语，过去分词跟 have 和 be；-ing 主动，-ed 被动，双写看重音。

core: 四形式：原形 / 过去式 / 过去分词 / 现在分词
过去式只作谓语；过去分词用于完成时、被动与非谓语
拼写：去 e、双写重读闭音节、ie 变 y、辅音 + y 变 ied
不规则四类 AAA/ABB/ABC/ABA
-ing 说明事物，-ed 说明人的感受
review.trigger: 看到 have/has/had 或 be 后面要填动词 → 一律先想过去分词 → 再核对不规则表

quickCheck.q: write 的四种形式？
quickCheck.a: write, wrote, written, writing。

quickCheck.q: 被动语态里 be 后面用过去式还是过去分词？
quickCheck.a: 过去分词，如 was written。

quickCheck.q: The film is ___ (bore). 填什么？
quickCheck.a: boring，说明电影令人乏味。

drills.stem: The letter ___ by the manager yesterday morning.
drills.explain: by the manager 表明被动，be 后须用过去分词 written；yesterday morning 限定为一般过去时。
drills.trap: was wrote 把过去式当过去分词使用，是最高频的形式错误。

drills.stem: She ___ (begin) to learn French, so she can now read simple novels in it.
drills.hint: 强调动作结果对现在的影响，用现在完成时。
drills.explain: 现在完成时用 has + 过去分词，begin 的过去分词是 begun。

drills.stem: He has went to Shanghai to attend an international conference.
drills.answer: He has gone to Shanghai to attend an international conference.
accept: He has gone to Shanghai to attend an international conference.
drills.explain: has 后接过去分词 gone，went 是过去式，不能用于现在完成时。

drills.stem: The children were ___ by the long lecture and started to yawn.
drills.explain: 主语 the children 是被讲座影响的人，说明人的感受用 -ed 形容词 bored。
drills.trap: boring 说明事物令人乏味，其主语应为 lecture 而不是 children。

drills.stem: 这本书是我去年写的。
drills.answer: This book was written by me last year.
drills.explain: 被动语态用 be + 过去分词，write 的过去分词是 written；last year 限定一般过去时。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The window was broken by a stone.
drills.explain: 被动语态由 was + 过去分词 broken 构成，by 引出动作执行者。

items.title: 情态动词的推测等级
items.brief: 推测强度可排序，否定只用 can't

concept.summary: 情态动词表推测时按可能性排成固定阶梯：must（一定）> should / ought to（按理应该）> may（可能）> might / could（或许）> can't / couldn't（不可能）。否定推测必须用 can't 或 couldn't，因为 mustn't 表示禁止而不是“不可能”。must 只用于肯定句，疑问句的推测用 can。

sections.p: 同一事实用不同情态动词，表示说话人把握程度不同。阶梯是可判定的：证据越直接越靠前，纯主观猜测靠后。
bullets: must：有直接证据，接近确定：The light is on, so he must be at home.
should / ought to：按常理或安排应当如此：He should be in the office by now.
may：有可能，不确定：She may be in the library.
might / could：可能性更弱，语气更犹豫：It might rain this afternoon.
can't / couldn't：有反证表明不可能：He can't be at home; I saw him leave.

sections.p: must 的否定形式不是 must not。must not 表示“禁止做某事”，与推测无关；表示“不可能”要用 can't 或 couldn't。这一条是改错题的固定考点。
bullets: √ He can't be serious.（他不可能当真）
× He mustn't be serious.（意为“他不得当真”，是禁止）
疑问推测用 can：Can it be true?（这可能是真的吗）

sections.p: 对现在的状态或习惯做推测，情态动词后接动词原形或 be；对过去做推测则用情态动词 + have done。情态动词本身没有人称与数的变化。
bullets: must be / may be / can't be + 形容词或名词
must do / may do / can't do + 动词原形
对过去的推测另用 must have done / can't have done

examples.en: The light is on, so he must be at home.
examples.zh: 灯亮着，所以他一定在家。
examples.note: 有直接证据（灯亮着），用 must 表接近确定的肯定推测。

examples.en: The light is on, so he mustn't be at home.
examples.zh: 灯亮着，所以他一定不在家。
examples.note: mustn't 表示禁止，不能表示“不可能”，应改为 can't be at home。

examples.en: He can't be at home; I saw him leave ten minutes ago.
examples.zh: 他不可能在家，我十分钟前看见他出去了。
examples.note: 有反证时否定推测用 can't，不用 mustn't。

examples.en: She may be in the library, but I am not sure.
examples.zh: 她可能在图书馆，但我不确定。
examples.note: may 表示有可能但不确定。

examples.en: According to the schedule, the train should arrive at nine.
examples.zh: 按照时刻表，火车应该九点到。
examples.note: should 表示按安排或常理应当如此。

examples.en: He must can swim very well.
examples.zh: 他游泳一定游得很好。
examples.note: 情态动词不能叠加，须说 He must be able to swim very well。

examples.en: It might snow tonight, so take a warm coat.
examples.zh: 今晚可能下雪，带件厚外套吧。
examples.note: might 表示较弱的可能性。

pitfalls.wrong: He mustn't be at home, for I saw him leave just now.
pitfalls.right: He can't be at home, for I saw him leave just now.
pitfalls.why: mustn't 表禁止，不表推测；有反证时的否定推测必须用 can't。

pitfalls.wrong: She must be know the answer.
pitfalls.right: She must know the answer.
pitfalls.why: 情态动词后接动词原形，不能接 be + 动词原形；只有推测现在状态时才用 must be + 形容词或名词。

pitfalls.wrong: The report may finished by Friday.
pitfalls.right: The report may be finished by Friday.
pitfalls.why: may 后接动词原形，被动结构须写成 may be + 过去分词。

contrast.diff: 本知识点处理对现在事实的推测；对过去事实的推测要把情态动词后的原形换成 have done。

concept.mnemonic: 一定 must，应该 should，可能 may，或许 might，不可能 can't；mustn't 是禁止，不是推测。

core: 强度阶梯：must > should > may > might/could > can't
否定推测用 can't / couldn't，绝不用 mustn't
must 只用于肯定句，疑问推测用 can
对现在的推测：情态动词 + 原形或 be
对过去的推测：情态动词 + have done
review.trigger: 看到“一定/可能/不可能”这类判断 → 先定强度 → 再检查是否否定，否定只能用 can't

quickCheck.q: must 的否定推测形式是什么？
quickCheck.a: can't 或 couldn't，不是 mustn't。

quickCheck.q: Can it be true? 为什么用 can？
quickCheck.a: 疑问句的推测用 can，must 不用于疑问推测。

quickCheck.q: may 与 might 的强度差别？
quickCheck.a: might 更弱、更犹豫。

drills.stem: The lights are on and the car is in the driveway, so he ___ be at home.
drills.explain: 两个直接证据使把握接近确定，肯定推测用 must；can 表推测只用于否定句和疑问句。
drills.trap: might 语法正确但强度不足，与前文的双重证据不匹配。

drills.stem: He ___ be serious — he is only joking with you.
drills.explain: 表示“不可能”用 can't；mustn't 意为“不得”，与句意不符。

drills.stem: He mustn't be at home, for I saw him leave just now.
drills.answer: He can't be at home, for I saw him leave just now.
accept: He can't be at home, for I saw him leave just now.
drills.explain: mustn't 表禁止，否定推测必须用 can't。

drills.stem: According to the timetable, the train ___ arrive at nine, but it is already nine thirty.
drills.explain: should 表示按安排或常理应当如此，与“已经九点半还没到”的落差相配合。
drills.trap: must 表“一定”，与列车已经晚点的事实矛盾。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He can't be at home at this hour.
drills.explain: 否定推测用 can't be，表示“不可能在家”。

drills.stem: 他不可能在办公室，灯是关着的。
drills.answer: He can't be in the office; the light is off.
drills.explain: 有反证（灯关着）时否定推测用 can't be；mustn't be 表示禁止。

items.title: 情态动词 + have done
items.brief: 对过去的推测与评价，一律加 have done

concept.summary: 情态动词 + have done 表示对过去事实的推测或评价，时间指向说话之前。判定依据是时间：句中出现 yesterday、last night、already 等过去时间，或上下文明显指向过去，就用 have done；对现在推测则用原形。在这一结构里，must have done 是一定做过，can't have done 是不可能做过，should have done 是本应做而没做。

sections.p: have done 是完成体形式，把判断对象锁定在过去。情态动词本身不变化，语义完全由情态动词承担。
bullets: must have done：对过去的肯定推测，证据充分：He must have missed the bus.
can't / couldn't have done：对过去的否定推测：She can't have finished so soon.
may / might have done：过去可能做过：They might have gone home.
should / ought to have done：本应做而没做，含责备：You should have told me.
shouldn't have done：本不该做却做了：You shouldn't have said that.
needn't have done：本不必做却做了：You needn't have bought so much food.

sections.h: 三组必须分清的评价义
sections.p: should have done 与 needn't have done 都含“与事实相反”的评价，但方向不同：前者是没做该做的，后者是做了不必做的。
bullets: should have done = 该做没做 → 责备或遗憾
shouldn't have done = 不该做却做了 → 责备
needn't have done = 不必做却做了 → 多余，无责备语气
could have done = 本来能够做却没做 → 惋惜

sections.h: needn't have done 与 didn't need to
sections.p: 两者都表示“没有必要”，但事实相反：needn't have done 是已经做了，didn't need to do 是没有做。这一组在选择题中常同时出现。
bullets: You needn't have watered the garden; it rained an hour later.（浇了，但没必要）
I didn't need to water the garden because it rained.（没浇，因为没必要）
needn't 本身就是情态动词的否定形式，后面不加 to

examples.en: The ground is wet, so it must have rained last night.
examples.zh: 地面是湿的，所以昨晚一定下过雨。
examples.note: must have done 表示对过去事实的肯定推测，证据是地面湿。

examples.en: She can't have finished the report so soon; it was due next week.
examples.zh: 她不可能这么快就完成了报告，报告下周才到期。
examples.note: can't have done 表示对过去的否定推测。

examples.en: You should have told me about the change earlier.
examples.zh: 你本该早点告诉我这个变动。
examples.note: should have done 表示本应做而没做，含责备。

examples.en: You should have came to the meeting on time.
examples.zh: 你本该准时到会。
examples.note: have 后必须用过去分词 come，不能用过去式 came。

examples.en: You needn't have bought so much bread; we already had plenty.
examples.zh: 你本不必买这么多面包，我们已经有很多了。
examples.note: needn't have done 表示做了但本不必做。

examples.en: I didn't need to buy any bread because we had plenty at home.
examples.zh: 我不必买面包，因为家里已经有很多。
examples.note: didn't need to do 表示没有必要，因此没有做。

examples.en: You needn't to have booked two rooms.
examples.zh: 你本不必订两个房间。
examples.note: needn't 本身已是情态动词的否定形式，后接 have done，不加 to。

pitfalls.wrong: He must have went home before the storm.
pitfalls.right: He must have gone home before the storm.
pitfalls.why: have 后接过去分词，go 的过去分词是 gone。

pitfalls.wrong: You mustn't have finished the work so quickly.
pitfalls.right: You can't have finished the work so quickly.
pitfalls.why: 对过去的否定推测用 can't have done，mustn't have done 不是英语中的推测结构。

pitfalls.wrong: You needn't to have watered the flowers.
pitfalls.right: You needn't have watered the flowers.
pitfalls.why: needn't 已是情态动词的否定形式，直接接 have done，不加 to。

contrast.diff: 推测等级处理对现在的判断，用情态动词 + 原形；本知识点把同一套等级平移到过去，用情态动词 + have done。

concept.mnemonic: must 一定，can't 不可能，should 本该，needn't 白做；过去一律加 have done。

core: 结构：情态动词 + have done，判断对象在过去
must have done 一定做过；can't have done 不可能做过
should have done 该做没做；shouldn't have done 不该做却做了
needn't have done 做了但不必；didn't need to do 没做
could have done 本来能却没做
review.trigger: 看到过去时间 + 情态动词 → 结构补成 have done → 再核对情态动词的语义

quickCheck.q: “他一定错过公交车了”怎么说？
quickCheck.a: He must have missed the bus.

quickCheck.q: needn't have done 与 didn't need to do 的事实差别？
quickCheck.a: 前者做了，后者没做。

quickCheck.q: should have done 表达什么语气？
quickCheck.a: 本应做而没做，含责备或遗憾。

drills.stem: The ground is wet everywhere, so it ___ last night.
drills.explain: last night 指向过去，地面湿是直接证据，故用 must have done 表肯定推测。
drills.trap: should have rained 表示“本应下雨而没下”，与地面湿的事实矛盾。

drills.stem: You ___ (should) tell me about the change earlier; I could have adjusted my plan.
drills.hint: 对过去的责备，结构为 should + have + 过去分词。
drills.explain: earlier 与 could have adjusted 都指向过去，表示“本应告诉而没告诉”，用 should have told。

drills.stem: You should have came to the meeting on time.
drills.answer: You should have come to the meeting on time.
accept: You should have come to the meeting on time.
drills.explain: have 后必须用过去分词，come 的过去分词与原形同形，不能用过去式 came。

drills.stem: You ___ have bought so much bread; we already had plenty in the cupboard.
drills.explain: 面包已经买了，但本不必买，用 needn't have done 表示白做了、没有责备语气。
drills.trap: mustn't have done 不是英语中的推测结构，mustn't 只表示禁止。

drills.stem: 他不可能已经完成了那份报告。
drills.answer: He can't have finished that report.
drills.explain: 对过去的否定推测用 can't have done；mustn't have done 不是合法结构。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She must have left her keys at home.
drills.explain: must have done 表示对过去的肯定推测，leave 的过去分词是 left。

items.title: 情态动词的委婉用法
items.brief: 过去式情态加疑问句式，降低强加度

concept.summary: 委婉的本质是降低请求对听者的强加度，手段有三条：把情态动词改成过去式（could/would/might）、把请求包装成疑问或否定疑问、加入缓冲语（possibly, I wonder if）。判定委婉是否到位，看情态动词形式与句式是否同时升级；只加 please 而保留 can you，委婉度并没有实质提高。形式上一旦用 would you mind，后面必须接动名词。

sections.p: 三条手段可以叠加，叠加越多语气越客气，日常表达控制在两层以内即可。
bullets: 过去式情态：can → could；will → would；may → might
疑问或否定疑问：Could you...? / Would you mind...? / Might I...?
缓冲语：possibly, perhaps, I was wondering if..., if you don't mind

sections.p: 这些句式已经固定，套用时不要改动其中的形式，尤其不能把动名词换成不定式。
bullets: Could you possibly do sth?（请求）
Would you mind doing sth?（请求，后接动名词）
I was wondering if you could do sth.（更间接，把请求包装成询问）
Would you like to do sth?（邀请，后接不定式）
Might I ask / suggest...?（正式场合的提议）

sections.p: Would you mind...? 的同意回答是 Not at all 或 Of course not，表示“不介意”；Never mind 用于安慰或表示“算了”，不能回答请求。
bullets: — Would you mind opening the window? — Not at all.
× Would you mind to open the window? → √ Would you mind opening the window?
× Could you please to help me? → √ Could you please help me?

examples.en: Could you possibly lend me your notes for the weekend?
examples.zh: 能不能把笔记借我周末用一下？
examples.note: could 是过去式情态，possibly 作缓冲语，两层委婉叠加。

examples.en: Would you mind closing the door behind you?
examples.zh: 你介意随手把门关上吗？
examples.note: would you mind 后接动名词 closing。

examples.en: Would you mind to close the door behind you?
examples.zh: 你介意随手把门关上吗？
examples.note: mind 后接动名词，应改为 closing。

examples.en: I was wondering if you could help me with the form.
examples.zh: 不知道你能不能帮我填一下这张表。
examples.note: 过去进行时加 if 从句，把请求包装成间接询问。

examples.en: Could you please to help me move the table?
examples.zh: 麻烦你帮我搬一下桌子好吗？
examples.note: could you please 后直接接动词原形，不带 to。

examples.en: Would you like to join us for dinner on Friday?
examples.zh: 周五愿意和我们一起吃饭吗？
examples.note: would like 后接不定式，用于邀请而非请求。

examples.en: Might I suggest a short break before we continue?
examples.zh: 我是否可以建议先短暂休息一下再继续？
examples.note: might 比 may 更委婉，多用于正式场合的提议。

pitfalls.wrong: Would you mind to turn down the music?
pitfalls.right: Would you mind turning down the music?
pitfalls.why: mind 后接动名词作宾语，turn 须变为 turning。

pitfalls.wrong: Could you please to send me the file again?
pitfalls.right: Could you please send me the file again?
pitfalls.why: could 是情态动词，后接动词原形，please 不改变这一结构。

pitfalls.wrong: — Would you mind my opening the window? — Never mind.
pitfalls.right: — Would you mind my opening the window? — Not at all.
pitfalls.why: Never mind 意为“没关系、算了”，用于安慰或放弃；同意对方请求应说 Not at all。

contrast.withTitle: 祈使句的构成与委婉形式
contrast.diff: 本知识点靠情态动词和疑问句式软化请求；祈使句部分讲的是动词开头的直接命令及其委婉附加成分。

concept.mnemonic: 过去式更客气，疑问比陈述软；mind 后面加 ing，please 后面跟原形。

core: 三条手段：过去式情态 / 疑问句式 / 缓冲语
could、would、might 比 can、will、may 委婉
Would you mind + doing；Would you like + to do
同意 Would you mind 用 Not at all，不用 Never mind
情态动词后一律接原形，please 不改变这一点
review.trigger: 看到请求或建议的句子 → 检查情态动词是否已换成过去式 → 再看 mind 后是否用了动名词

quickCheck.q: Would you mind 后面接什么形式？
quickCheck.a: 动名词，如 Would you mind opening the window?

quickCheck.q: Could you please 后面能加 to 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，直接接动词原形。

quickCheck.q: Would you mind...? 的同意答语是什么？
quickCheck.a: Not at all. 或 Of course not.

drills.stem: ___ you possibly lend me your notes for the weekend?
drills.explain: could 是 can 的过去式形式，用于请求时比 can 委婉，possibly 进一步缓冲。
drills.trap: Must 表义务或禁止，用于请求不合语义，也无法与 possibly 搭配。

drills.stem: Would you mind ___ (turn) down the music a little?
drills.explain: mind 后接动名词作宾语，turn 直接加 -ing 构成 turning。

drills.stem: Would you mind to close the door behind you?
drills.answer: Would you mind closing the door behind you?
accept: Would you mind closing the door behind you?
drills.explain: mind 后接动名词，to close 是不定式，结构错误。

drills.stem: — Would you mind if I used your phone for a minute? — ___
drills.explain: Not at all 表示“一点也不介意”，是对 Would you mind 的同意回答。
drills.trap: Never mind 意为“没关系、算了”，用于安慰或撤回话题，不能表示同意请求。

drills.stem: 你能帮我一个忙吗？（语气委婉）
drills.answer: Could you do me a favour?
drills.explain: 用 could 代替 can 构成委婉请求，后接动词原形 do；favour 为英式拼写，favor 为美式拼写。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Could you possibly help me with this form?
drills.explain: could + possibly 构成委婉请求，后接动词原形 help。

items.title: 助动词 do 的强调与替代
items.brief: do 的第三、第四功能：强调谓语与替代

concept.summary: 助动词 do/does/did 除构成疑问与否定外，还有两个独立功能：强调谓语和替代上文出现的动词短语。强调的公式是 do/does/did + 动词原形，只用于肯定句和肯定祈使句，且不能与已有的助动词或情态动词叠加。替代时 do 的时态与人称跟随被替代的谓语，so do I / neither do I 中的助动词必须与原句一致。

sections.p: 看 do 后面接什么、句子是什么语气，就能区分三种功能。后接原形且句子为肯定，是强调；后接原形且句子为疑问或否定，是构成疑问否定；单独出现且指向上文的动作，是替代。
bullets: 构成疑问否定：Do you like it? / He doesn't like it.
强调谓语：I do like it. / He did finish it.（后接原形，重读）
替代动词短语：— Who broke it? — Tom did. / She sings well, and so does her brother.

sections.p: 强调用法受结构限制，违反任何一条都会写出不合语法的句子。
bullets: 只用于肯定句：× I don't do like it.
后接动词原形：× He does likes music. → √ He does like music.
不能与已有助动词或情态动词叠加：× He does can swim. → √ He can swim.
祈使句的强调用 Do + 原形：Do be careful. / Do come early.

sections.p: do 替代的是整个谓语短语，因此时态由原句决定，人称由新主语决定；so/neither 引导的呼应句要沿用原句的助动词，不能一律用 do。
bullets: — Who broke the window? — Tom did.（did 替代 broke the window）
She sings well, and so does her brother.（原句是一般现在时的实义动词，呼应句用 does）
— I have never been there. — Neither have I.（原句用 have，呼应句沿用 have）

examples.en: I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
examples.zh: 我确实希望你能重新考虑这个决定。
examples.note: do 用于强调谓语 hope，后接动词原形。

examples.en: She does look tired after the long journey.
examples.zh: 长途旅行之后她看上去确实很累。
examples.note: does 强调谓语 look，主语第三人称单数时用 does。

examples.en: He does likes classical music.
examples.zh: 他确实喜欢古典音乐。
examples.note: 强调结构后必须用动词原形，应改为 does like。

examples.en: — Who broke the window? — Tom did.
examples.zh: ——谁打破了窗户？——汤姆。
examples.note: did 替代 broke the window，避免重复整个谓语短语。

examples.en: She sings well, and so does her brother.
examples.zh: 她唱得很好，她弟弟也是。
examples.note: so does + 主语构成肯定呼应，助动词形式与原句一致。

examples.en: — I don't like coffee. — So don't I.
examples.zh: ——我不喜欢咖啡。——我也不喜欢。
examples.note: 否定呼应应用 Neither do I 或 Nor do I，so 只用于肯定呼应。

examples.en: Do be careful when you cross the street.
examples.zh: 过马路时一定要小心。
examples.note: 祈使句的强调用 Do + 动词原形，be 保留原形。

pitfalls.wrong: He did went to the library yesterday afternoon.
pitfalls.right: He did go to the library yesterday afternoon.
pitfalls.why: did 已承担过去时，后面的实义动词必须用原形。

pitfalls.wrong: I do can swim across the river.
pitfalls.right: I can swim across the river.
pitfalls.why: 情态动词本身可以重读表强调，不能再叠加助动词 do。

pitfalls.wrong: — I have never been to Tibet. — Neither do I.
pitfalls.right: — I have never been to Tibet. — Neither have I.
pitfalls.why: 呼应句的助动词必须与原句一致，原句用 have，呼应句也用 have。

contrast.diff: 本知识点讲 do 的三种功能与强调的四条限制；替代部分专门处理 so/neither 呼应句与 do so 结构的选择。

concept.mnemonic: do 后接原形才是强调，肯定句里才能用；替代看时态，呼应看助动词。

core: do/does/did 三功能：疑问否定、强调谓语、替代动词短语
强调公式：do/does/did + 动词原形，只用于肯定句
不能与助动词或情态动词叠加
祈使句强调：Do be careful. / Do come early.
呼应句沿用原句助动词：Neither have I. / So does her brother.
review.trigger: 看到 do 后跟动词原形且句子是肯定句 → 判定为强调 → 再检查是否与已有助动词冲突

quickCheck.q: He does likes music. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 强调结构后必须用原形，应为 does like。

quickCheck.q: “我确实喜欢它”怎么强调？
quickCheck.a: I do like it.

quickCheck.q: — I have never been there. 的否定呼应句？
quickCheck.a: Neither have I.

drills.stem: I ___ hope you will reconsider your decision before Friday.
drills.explain: do 用于强调谓语 hope，主语 I 用 do，后接动词原形。
drills.trap: does 用于第三人称单数主语，与 I 不一致；done 不能作助动词。

drills.stem: She ___ (do) look elegant in that dress.
drills.hint: 主语第三人称单数，强调结构用 does。
drills.explain: 强调谓语 look 时用 does + 动词原形，主语 She 决定用 does。

drills.stem: He did went to the library yesterday afternoon.
drills.answer: He did go to the library yesterday afternoon.
accept: He did go to the library yesterday afternoon.
drills.explain: did 已承担过去时，后面的实义动词必须用原形 go。

drills.stem: — I have never been to Tibet. — ___
drills.explain: 原句为否定句且助动词是 have，否定呼应句须用 Neither have I。
drills.trap: Neither do I 的助动词与原句不一致，do 不能替代 have。

drills.stem: 她确实喜欢古典音乐。
drills.explain: 强调谓语 like 用 does + 原形，主语 She 决定用 does。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He does look tired after the long journey.
drills.explain: does 强调谓语 look，后接形容词 tired 作表语。
